deadline.value: The main round closes on 1 December 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong time. The department has rolling start dates and considers late applications subject to space.

also.quote: Applications received after deadline will be considered subject to the number of student places left outside the main admission round.

gre_subject.value: No distinct GRE Subject Test policy was identified on the programme or central pages checked.

supervisor.value: Upload the proposed supervisor’s consent email with the department application checklist.

also.quote: must complete and upload this Check Sheet together with all required documents prescribed in the application guide to the online application system.

funding.value: Eligible full-time applicants are considered on academic merit. The studentship can run up to four years with annual renewal based on progress and duties. The published 2026/27 rates are HK$19,100 monthly before the qualifying exam and HK$19,600 after it.
funding.quote: The postgraduate studentship is granted on the basis of academic merit.

also.quote: Continuation and renewal of the award are subject to satisfactory study progress, achievement in coursework results and performance in any academic-related duties assigned.
PhD students may be granted the studentship for a maximum of four years
the studentship Basic Rate is HK$19,100 per month (~US$2,440) and Advance Rate is HK$19,600 per month (~US$2,510).

entry_route.value: A first-class honours bachelor's degree or equivalent, a recognised master's degree, or a higher research degree can qualify. CityUHK MPhil transfer is a separate route.
entry_route.quote: hold a Bachelor’s degree with first class honours (or equivalent qualification) from a recognised university.

also.quote: hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent qualification) from a recognised university;

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4.5 for tests from 21 January 2026. The previous scale minimum was 79. Scores must be valid at submission and are valid for two years.
toefl_min.quote: a score of 79 (for tests taken prior to 21 January 2026) or 4.5 (for tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards) (Internet-based test) in the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL)

also.quote: TOEFL and IELTS scores are considered valid for two years from the test date and must be valid at the time of submission of application.

notes: Official research-degree catalogue: https://www.cityu.edu.hk/catalogue/pg/202627/programme/BMS3_P.htm. The department and catalogue explicitly describe research training in both biology and biomedical sciences. The department links a checklist bearing the previous BMS2/P code. Its current catalogue record is BMS3/P. The separate CityUHK–Cornell interdisciplinary veterinary PhD and other Jockey Club College research doctorates are documented for classification in OWNER_REVIEW.md.
